'''Jannimak Crash Site Outpost''' was a scientific research base constructed by the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]] in [[3622 BBY]] next to the [[Jannimak crash site|crash site]] of [[Jannimak]], an advanced [[research vessel]] carrying exotic life forms and capable of terraforming the surrounding environment to accommodate the needs of its species. Led by [[Pordav|Doctor Pordav]], and aided by the GSI that provided all the necessary resources including security, a scientific team arrived to study and contain the phenomena occurring within the crash site.<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" />

Apart from scientists' temporary quarters and a medical tent, the outpost also hosted a vendor selling research notes to [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] contractors, that could help them in exploring the [[Jannimak crash site|crash site]]. There also was a [[stronghold directory terminal]], selling real estate on Dantooine.<ref>{{TORcite|Crash Site Outpost|[[Dantooine]]|type=location|exp=lots}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jannimak Crash Outpost first appeared in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
